item.title: Instead of managing billions, Warren Buffett’s son Howard Buffett chose farming
item.description: Choosing a path less traveled, Howard Buffett, the son of Warren Buffett, dedicated his life to farming and conservation rather than finance. He skillfully managed farms in Nebraska and Illinois, prioritizing soil health. Warren Buffett supported his passion by purchasing a Nebraska farm for his son. As he transitions to the role of non-executive chairman at Berkshire Hathaway, Howard aims to safeguard the company’s culture following his father's legacy. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: A federal appeals court has determined that the US Constitution does not explicitly provide a right to clean drinking water. Although the court acknowledged the severity of these claims, it denied the establishment of a constitutional right to safe water and pointed to different legal recourses. item.title: La pugna por la sucesión del rey de la monarquía de Tooro, considerado el más joven del mundo
item.description: Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, rey de la monarquía de Tooro en Uganda, de 34 años, considerado el rey más joven del mundo, murió el pasado 27 de agosto, y su fallecimiento abrió una nueva pugna entre príncipes de Tooro. La princesa Ruth Komuntale, hermana del difunto rey, denuncia que algunos integrantes del clan manipularon el proceso y se opone a la decisión del comité, que anunció como heredero al popular presentador de noticias de televisión, el príncipe Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma, de 56 años.
